title: Customer escalation war-room - Zeppelin LLC (2026-03-13)
content:
Objective:
- Prep notes for 1st war-room with Zeppelin LLC (customer-facing). Align on immediate mitigations, communication plan, and next-step owners.

Context / summary:
- Customer: Zeppelin LLC (payments platform). Reported elevated tail latency and 500s on text-generation endpoint in us-west-2 since ~2026-03-13 02:30 PDT. Impact: multiple requests failing; customer reports timeouts from their production load-test.
- Severity: P1 (customer-visible outage for production traffic).
- Initial telemetry: spike in token-level latency and memory paging observed on several dedicated nodes serving model r-xl-8k-q3.
- Recent change window: none for customer-specific routing, but autoscaler config was updated yesterday (2026-03-12) to reduce burst capacity threshold.

Attendees (invite list):
- Maya Gupta (CS lead, owner)
- Jordan Blake (SRE)
- Sanjay Rao (Infra / serving-runtime)
- Priya Khanna (Solutions Eng) - customer contact
- Tom Alvarez (Oncall Eng)
- optional: Legal/Trust if escalates to data/privacy questions

Agenda (30-45 min):
- 0-5m Intake: confirm customer-reported symptoms and SLA impact (Priya)
- 5-15m Data review: metrics (p95/p99 latency, error rates, CPU/GPU mem, OOMs) (Jordan/Sanjay)
- 15-25m Containment options: routing fallback, scale-up, temporary model swap, increase burst capacity (Sanjay/Tom)
- 25-35m Customer comms: message templates, cadence, who speaks (Maya/Priya)
- 35-45m Action items and owners, timeline to next update

Known facts (from initial telemetry):
- p99 latency for generation rose from ~1200ms to ~6-8s across r-xl-8k-q3 nodes at 02:30 PDT.
- Error rate (5xx) jumped from 0.2% to ~9% in the affected shard set.
- GPU memory in affected pods showed fragmentation and transient page-fault spikes. No complete OOMs yet.
- Autoscaler logs show several scale-in events in the 01:30-02:00 window due to the new threshold; scale-out lag noted under burst.

Initial hypotheses (to validate):
1) Autoscaler policy change caused insufficient warm capacity for a sudden load pattern shift -> queuing and increased tail latency.
2) Model runtime regression (recent kernel change) causing increased memory usage on r-xl-8k-q3.
3) Upstream customer traffic pattern changed (big longer-context requests) causing KV cache pressure and unexpected memory pattern.

Immediate mitigation options (pros/cons):
- Temporarily increase dedicated pool capacity / bump burst threshold (fast, likely to reduce latency; may increase cost). Owner: Sanjay. ETA: 20-30m to apply and validate.
- Route Zeppelin traffic to a lower-capacity but stable model variant (r-xl-4k-q3) and scale accordingly (requires customer opt-in; potential quality degradation). Owner: Priya. ETA: 30-60m.
- Force rolling restart of affected nodes to clear fragmentation (disruptive, short-term fix). Owner: Tom. ETA: 15-25m but risk of transient higher errors.
- Enable per-request soft timeouts & retries on our gateway to reduce 5xx surface (gateway config change). Owner: Jordan. ETA: 15m.

Customer communication plan (first external message within 10m):
- Sender: Priya (SE) + Maya (CS).
- Message points: acknowledging issue, current impact, working on mitigation, ETA for next update (T+15m), contact channel (war-room / dedicated Slack thread), recommended temporary action for customer (pause large long-context jobs if possible).
- Tone: transparent, prioritizing mitigations and next-updates cadence.

Triage checklist (what we need to surface during meeting):
- Confirm whether customer traffic spiked in request size (longer seq) or request rate. (Priya)
- Share autoscaler decision logs and timeline (Jordan).
- Check recent infra deploys and runtime kernel changes (Sanjay).
- Collect quick sample of failing requests (IDs) for replay (Tom).
- Validate if similar errors seen for other customers in the same shard/region (Jordan).

Action items (post-meeting follow-ups):
- Sanjay: immediately increase burst_threshold to previous value & add capacity to Zeppelin pool. Provide confirmation + metrics within 30m. (Due: 2026-03-13T10:00:00Z)
- Jordan: enable gateway soft-retries and add short (2s) per-request soft timeout to reduce 5xx exposure. Report error-rate delta in 15m. (Due: 2026-03-13T09:50:00Z)
- Priya: coordinate with Zeppelin on whether they accept temporary model downgrade and send customer-facing update. Post their decision in war-room slack. (Due: 2026-03-13T09:40:00Z)
- Tom: collect and attach 10 failing request samples with headers + tracing IDs to JIRA-4821. (Due: 2026-03-13T09:35:00Z)
- Maya: draft external status update (short) and approve before send; schedule T+15/T+45 updates. (Due: 2026-03-13T09:25:00Z)
- All: join 15-min check-in at T+15 for status and decide on next actions. (Meeting follow-up)

Notes-to-self / reminders:
- Keep comms succinct; include concrete ETA and whether we've applied mitigations.
- If we roll nodes, coordinate with SRE to avoid cascading restarts across same shard.
- If mitigation fails after 45m, escalate to Exec + Legal for potential SLA credit conversation.

Post-mortem pointers (for later):
- Reproduce timeline with autoscaler metrics and node-level memory fragmentation graphs.
- Evaluate if autoscaler thresholds need additional cooldown/guardrails for dedicated pools.
- Add regression tests for kernel memory behavior on r-xl-8k-q3.

Quick templates:
- External status (short): "We are investigating elevated errors and latency impacting your text-generation endpoint. Our engineers are actively working on mitigation and we'll update you in 15 minutes. Sorry for the disruption."
- Internal update (war-room): "Applied burst_threshold rollback at T+xx. Observed p99 drop from 8s->2.3s on affected pool. Monitoring for error-rate improvement."

Raw links / refs to pull during meeting:
- Autoscaler logs: https://internal.redwood.ai/logs/autoscaler/2026-03-13
- Error dashboards: https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/errors/zeppelin-us-west-2
- JIRA ticket: JIRA-4821

End of prep notes. Keep this doc as the single source for war-room since it's a user scratchpad - I'll copy key items into the war-room slack thread and the Jira ticket.
